title: Rabbits, Belgian hares, to be kept off ground; penalty.
bodyText:
(a) Any person who breeds, raises, or keeps rabbits or Belgian hares shall keep them off the ground.

(b) Any person who violates this section shall be guilty of a petty misdemeanor.
crossReferences: Classification of offense and authorized punishment, see §§701-107, 706-640, and 706-663.
